If sentiment is >0.5 in the last 3 days and forecast is trending up, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days).  
If sentiment is <0.3 and forecast is trending down, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is >0.5 and forecast is trending down, reverse direction by +2–3% for late horizon (16–30 days).  
If sentiment is <0.3 and forecast is flat, add 0.5–1.0% to forecast for early horizon to counteract pessimism.  
If sentiment is >0.5 and forecast is above 75% of recent high, cap forecast at 75% of recent high for mid horizon.  
If sentiment is <0.3 and forecast is below 70% of recent low, add 1.0–2.0% to forecast for late horizon to avoid underestimation.
